currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated complete cathedral and detached bell tower: six-column west portico, triangular pediment/three roofline figures, long gray nave roof, two rear domed chapels/lanterns, side colonnades and a separate round-base/faceted staged white clock/bell tower with dark spire. Palace, square paving and monuments remain outside the model.

Inspected elevated close front: six tapered plain round columns with restrained capitals, real open portico, recessed central door, selected sculptural niches, broad entablature and triangular relief field, three top figures with tall central gold cross, gray metal gable roof and two dark rear chapel domes with pale open lanterns. Exact reliefs and sculpture omitted.
